entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Ugh, finally. I need to return something.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. I can certainly help you with that. Can I get your name and order number to start?
Sarah Miller. The order number is VF8-675-309.
Thank you, Sarah. I see you're calling about the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor. To get started, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's not an 'issue'. I just don't want it anymore. Plans changed.
I understand. I'm just trying to understand the situation a bit better. You mentioned plans changed?
Look, we had an emergency. My husband got a surprise deployment notice, and then I ended up in the hospital for an unexpected surgery. A fitness band is the last thing on my mind right now.
Oh, I am very sorry to hear that, Sarah. That sounds like a lot to handle all at once. I hope you're recovering well. Let me take a look at the return policy for you right away.

Okay, just one moment... I see here that the VeloBand was delivered to you 43 days ago. Our policy allows for returns within 10 days, so you are unfortunately outside the timeframe. I can absolutely process that return for a full refund for you.
Oh. I was expecting to have to argue about it. Whatever, that's fine.

Not at all, I'm happy to make this easy for you. I am emailing a prepaid return label to the address on file now. Just pack the VeloBand back in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once our warehouse receives it, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method. Can I help with anything else?
No. That's it. At least something was simple.
I'm glad I could help resolve this for you. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope things get better for you and your family soon.
